guard_used: the PRODUCT function: second_witness_grades(bars, t) in data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/second_witness_guard.py, imported and called for every row and every security-day of the sizings and of the repeat count (its three conditions: a positive bar for t; a positive bar for the calendar's prior trading day; the two differ by more than the relative tolerance 1e-4). The reproduction under guard sentence (1) alone uses IB-pr-445's own function (ib445_measure.grade_row with relative 1e-4), unchanged.

second_sentence.why: In the sizing a row is graded only against a positive bar for the day AND for the prior trading day (ib442_measure.classify returns no_bar_for_the_day_or_prior when either is missing), so the no-prior-bar sentence is already how rows were blocked under sentence (1) alone; the cost is the difference this run measures, not an assumption.

the_five_cost.basis: freed = freed_and_holding_no_other_ungradeable_kind; accounts_no_longer_ever_served = accounts_never_served with the five not graded less the same with them graded; counts only

repeating_on_more_than_half_their_days.rule_in_words: For a security of one of the nine admitted pairs that is OUTSIDE the first witness (it sits behind an OUTSIDE_ANCHOR row of the sizing's account-days) and has at least one bar, take the 85 graded days (2026-06-10 to 2026-10-09). days_with_a_bar = the graded days on which the reader (Yahoo Finance unadjusted Close) has a positive bar for the day. days_not_graded = those days on which the guard (the product function second_witness_grades, both sentences: no grade where the bar equals the prior trading day's bar within relative 1e-4, and no grade where there is no bar for the calendar's prior trading day) gives no grade. The security repeats on more than half its days when 2 * days_not_graded > days_with_a_bar. A security the first witness also carries on some days counts as outside it when it has an OUTSIDE_ANCHOR row on some graded day (the cell's own definition of the sizing population).

fetch.reader: fetch_yahoo (data/assets/scripts/silver/commonwealth_price_basis_census.py) / read_yahoo_close (data/assets/scripts/silver/commonwealth_daily_valuation.py), neither edited; unadjusted Close

control.what_it_is: planted trading days of the calendar: a security of an admitted pair whose bar moves, repeats, moves again, and a gap; an account-day holding it on a moved day is freed with the security graded and NOT freed when it is in the not-graded list; on the repeated day and on the day after a missing bar it is not freed. Run through row_outcome / day_outcome, the functions the real run uses.

what_is_assumed: A SIZING, not a stamp: IF every account-day that holds, outside the first witness, only securities graded by the second witness at the day's close took the claim its rows give (IB-pr-442's rule, imported unchanged), with the guard's two sentences (no grade where the reader's bar equals its bar for the prior trading day; no grade where it has no bar for the calendar's prior trading day) and, in the second sizing, with five named securities given no grade on any day, the claim counts and the serving rule would read as below; every other account-day keeps the claim it has under the cash rule in force, and nothing is re-graded, admitted or excluded in the product.
not_established: Whether the nine pairs should be admitted, or any security excluded: this cell sizes and recommends nothing.
Whether the moved days of the five securities (ADLYX, BISOX, EIBLX, GPPIX, OLCYX) are dated right: no anchor close exists for them, so nothing here checks the date of a moved bar.
Why the reader's bar repeats (a stale feed, a fund that does not move, or a late publication): the counts cannot tell them apart.
That the claims counted as freed would be correct: freed account-days are a count of account-days no witness is barred from grading, not a check that the claim is right.

Anything outside the 85 graded days (2026-06-10 to 2026-10-09) or outside the 303 tickers asked; securities with no ticker, no type or mixed types, or another type are not graded and are not counted in the repeat list.
Securities for which the reader returned nothing are not graded (their rows block the account-day); the count is in fetch.tickers_with_no_bars.
The second sentence's cost is read from rows of the sizing's population only; a security-day nobody holds is counted in the repeat list, not in any cost.
